name: gd32h7
title: GigaDevice GD32H7
description: Open-source PlatformIO development platform for GigaDevice GD32H7xx ARM Cortex-M7 MCUs and the GD32H759I-EVAL development board, bundling CMSIS, GD32H7xx Standard Peripheral Library (V1.4.0), USBHS library, and GD32H759I-EVAL Board Support Package (LCD/TLI, GT911 Touch, EXMC SDRAM, SDIO0 + FatFs, I2S Audio, OSPI Flash, EEPROM, DCI Camera).
